dataset_origin.limitations: Not real customers or documents. One monetary unit without tax or unagreed charges; no time window or status-change history. Complete unique order-line registry, unique operation IDs, valid non-null foreign keys, positive integer quantities, nonnegative money, returns accepted/rejected and credits posted/draft.

publication_note: Local machine paths, instance addresses and session/storage identifiers are omitted. Verification statements describe the original run; private evidence is not included. Public datasets, versions and content hashes are retained.
